evals.prompt: The watch-room follower sometimes seeks backward by a few seconds right after the host pauses. It's intermittent but happens roughly 1 in 10 times. Figure out what's going on.
evals.expected_output: Build a red-capable feedback loop before forming a fix hypothesis. Prefer a focused unit test via bun run test against syncReducer or sync-math; for the intermittent timing issue, raise the reproduction rate with repeated runs, pinned time, seeded randomness, or narrower inputs around the suspected timing window. Confirm the loop matches the exact symptom (backward seek after host pause). Only then list 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses, testing one at a time. Read docs/conventions/data-fetching.md and the relevant Next.js cache rules if stale-data/caching is suspected; use the R2 route and docs/conventions/supabase-security.md for auth/RLS issues.
expectations: Creates or identifies a red-capable loop (e.g. a focused unit/component test via bun run test, or a temporary harness around the smallest callable module) BEFORE forming a fix hypothesis
Confirms the loop matches the user's exact symptom (backward seek right after host pause), not a nearby failure
For the intermittent timing issue, raises the reproduction rate via repeated runs, pinned time, seeded randomness, narrower inputs, or stress around the suspected timing window
Lists 3-5 ranked falsifiable hypotheses and tests them one at a time, rather than jumping to a single fix

evals.prompt: The room list page feels slow — it probably is the Supabase query. Go ahead and add an index and optimize the select while you're in there.
evals.expected_output: Reject jumping to a fix before a failing reproduction loop exists. For a perf regression, establish a baseline and narrow the hot path first (measure before fixing). No red-capable loop has been built yet and the symptom has not been confirmed against the user's exact path. Build the loop (prefer bun run test or a deterministic harness), measure the baseline, then hypothesize. Adding a DB index / optimizing a select is a fix hypothesis that must come after repro + minimize, not before.
expectations: Rejects adding an index / optimizing the select as a fix before a red-capable reproduction loop exists
For the performance regression, requires establishing a baseline and narrowing the hot path before fixing (measure first)
Requires building a red-capable loop and confirming it matches the symptom before hypothesizing
